description: This PHP source file defines a migration class for the OrangeHRM system, specifically for version 5.0.0 beta. It includes database schema updates, permission insertions, UI configuration, and email template updates related to HRM features.

classes.name: Migration
classes.description: A class extending AbstractMigration that performs database schema changes, permission setup, and email template updates for HRM system upgrade.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Executes the migration steps including schema updates, permission insertions, and email template configurations.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Returns the version string of the migration, '5.0-beta'.

methods.name: updateHomePage
methods.description: Updates the home page URL for a given user role.

methods.name: getEmailIdByName
methods.description: Retrieves the email ID from the database by email name, caching results.

methods.name: updateEmailProcessorClassByEmailName
methods.description: Updates the email processor class for a specific email by name.

methods.name: updateEmailTemplateSubjectAndBodyByEmailNameAndRecipientRole
methods.description: Updates email template subject and body for a specific email, recipient role.

methods.name: getReportDisplayGroupId
methods.description: Retrieves the ID of a report display group by name, with caching.

methods.name: updateReportDisplayFieldByGroup
methods.description: Updates the class name for report display fields within a specific group.

methods.name: updateReportFilterFieldByFieldName
methods.description: Updates the class name for report filter fields by field name.

methods.name: renameReportDisplayFieldAlias
methods.description: Renames the alias of a report display field.

methods.name: renameSelectedReportFilterFieldWhereCondition
methods.description: Renames the where condition value for selected report filter fields.

methods.name: updateReportDisplayFieldByFieldAlias
methods.description: Updates the class name for report display fields by field alias.

methods.name: updateScreenModuleId
methods.description: Updates the module ID for a specific screen identified by URL and name.

methods.name: updateMenuItemIconNames
methods.description: Updates the icon name in menu item additional parameters for a given menu title.
